scope.objective: Prioritize phone-resident ASR, response-backbone, and TTS sweeps for a robust low-latency multilingual offline speech agent.
constraints: Do not train, finetune, or perform heavy conversion on the MacBook.
Use Colab for heavyweight source export or conversion and Qualcomm AI Hub for QNN compile, link, profile, and inference jobs.
Do not replace the accepted application or runtime APKs until a candidate passes its isolated gate.
Do not keep multiple large backbones resident merely to switch per turn.
Treat remote component latency as placement evidence, not physical-phone end-to-end latency.

evidence_classes.phone_measured: Executed on NX809J with real model input and stage-specific or end-to-end measurements.
evidence_classes.phone_compatibility: Executed on NX809J, but only as an isolated or synthetic compatibility probe.
evidence_classes.exact_target_hub: Account-owned Qualcomm AI Hub result on Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 QRD / SM8850 / HTP v81.
evidence_classes.exact_target_published: Qualcomm-published exact-target result; not reproduced under the application UID.
evidence_classes.same_generation_proxy: Published or measured on another HTP-v81 retail target such as Galaxy S26.
evidence_classes.host_measured: Measured on the Apple M2 or Colab; useful for screening, not phone latency.
evidence_classes.projected: No execution result for the claimed device/runtime path.

global_acceptance.stage_isolation: Change one stage per sweep and retain the accepted stack as control.
global_acceptance.npu_proof: Record provider selection, disabled CPU fallback where supported, process UID, loaded QNN/HTP libraries, FastRPC/DMA evidence, and per-stage timing.
global_acceptance.quality: Use fixed-language EN/ZH/JA/KO/RU fixtures first, then at least 100 representative utterances per language before a robustness claim.
global_acceptance.latency: Warm end-of-VAD to first-audio proxy at most 2.0 s median and 3.0 s P95; stage gates are ASR P95 <=700 ms, first-speakable P95 <=1.25 s, and TTS first chunk <=700 ms where the selected voice can meet it.
global_acceptance.memory: Measure PSS/RSS with the selected ASR, exactly one response backbone, and one TTS engine resident. Reject accidental dual-backbone residency.
global_acceptance.offline: Repeat airplane-mode, force-stop, reboot, host-ADB shutdown, literal unplug, and microphone turns before promotion.
global_acceptance.audio: Reject non-finite, near-silent, clipped, wrong-language, dropped, or queue-starving output; require native-speaker listening for JA/KO/RU/ZH naturalness.
